name: 🎯 Snipe or Swap
desc:
Welcome to Snipe or Swap! 🎯

🔫 One sniper. Everyone else runs!
🏃 Survive, dodge shots, and use abilities to stay alive!
💰 Earn cash, unlock abilities, and collect sniper skins!
🔥 Build win streaks and dominate every round!

⭐ Like the game for more updates!

Will you hit the shot… or escape the sniper? 🎯
